catalog.name: Windows PC
catalog.description: Work on your Windows PC — shell, files, screen.
catalog.hint: The name is how you and the agent refer to this computer ("check the logs on my-laptop"). Adding it hands you a one-liner to run on that machine.

steps: Add the computer here — a one-time command appears straight away, and `Connect` on its card brings it back later.
Run that command in `PowerShell` on the computer you want to connect — it installs a small agent that dials this sandbox.
Nothing is opened on your network: the connection is outbound, so no port forwarding and no VPN.
You can revoke it any time from this card; `intentic-host uninstall` removes the agent from the machine.

catalog.name: Linux PC
catalog.description: Work on your Linux PC — shell, files, desktop.
catalog.hint: The name is how you and the agent refer to this computer ("run the tests on my-desktop"). Adding it hands you a one-liner to run on that machine.

steps: Add the computer here — a one-time command appears straight away, and `Connect` on its card brings it back later.
Run that command in a terminal on the computer you want to connect — it installs a small agent that dials this sandbox.
Nothing is opened on your network: the connection is outbound, so no port forwarding and no VPN.
You can revoke it any time from this card; `intentic-host uninstall` removes the agent from the machine.
